Harmony is a minimalistic library for stitching composable architectures. Think of it as a lightweight kernel that enables you to assemble complex systems from independent features, promoting composability, and reducing complexity.

## Key features

- **Unified platform**. Declaratively compose features into shell applications.
- **Feature compositions**. An API first approach for composing components into unified platforms.
- **Framework Agnostic**. Build with your preferred frameworks and tools, maximizing flexibility.
- **Gradual Adoption:**  Integrate Harmony incrementally, adapting it to your existing architecture and workflows.

## Get started

Launch the [Harmony Quickstart](https://bit.dev/docs/quick-start/harmony) to build your first composable platform.

Start an Harmony platform with React:

```
bit new harmony my-platform --aspect bitdev.symphony/envs/symphony-env
```

Start a bare Harmony platform:

```
bit new harmony my-platform --aspect bitdev.harmony/harmony-env
```
